missing: No source has measured a real blanket's draw over a full night on a power station. The sources' estimates of how much power a blanket uses vary from 60 W to 260 W, so they disagree on how big a station you need: anywhere from about 1 kWh to about 2.6 kWh. A shopper is left without a tested answer or a single current-priced pick for a full night.
why: This search is open. The only major reviewer, TechRadar, has a deal post on one bundle, and it says it hasn't tested that model. Two niche sites name models for this question (homepowerfacts and blackoutwise), but both base their numbers on spec calculations, not testing. Their assumptions are also far apart, so they recommend very different stations. The rest of the readable results are calculators or a maker's blog post, and six results had no text at all. A focused page that measures how much power a blanket really draws over a night and gives a current-priced pick at about 1 kWh would stand out.
